presentAttendanceDescription: Number of vendors and supervisors who marked attendance as present for the selected date/period.
absentAttendanceDescription: Number of vendors and supervisors who were absent or did not mark attendance for the selected date/period.
totalAttendanceDescription: Overall attendance statistics for vendors and supervisors in the selected date/period and location.
topPerformersDescription: Top 3 performers ranked by attendance score. Monthly score = attendance % for selected month. Yearly score = average attendance % across all months in the selected year.
performanceScoreDescription: Performance score is calculated based on CSC Cleaning percentage: (CSC Cleaned / CSC Not Cleaned) × 100. Score is shown for each location over the selected time period (monthly or yearly).
